name: Multi-Agent Lead Gen & Account Sign-Up Campaign
description: Orchestrates 4 cloud machines to perform web research, SaaS account sign-up, Obsidian Vault report syncing, and Discord alert dispatch.

workflow.description: Fleet Orchestrator provisions fleet and parses user prompt keywords.
Research Agent launches Chromium and extracts brand & founder intelligence.
Sign-Up Agent opens registration page, inputs credentials, and creates account.
Obsidian Agent generates Markdown report file inside Obsidian Vault.
Fleet Orchestrator dispatches completion alert to Discord/Telegram channel.
